mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, u.dept_id AS 'deptId', u.tenant_id AS 'tenantId', u.username AS 'username', u.`password` AS 'password', u.real_name AS 'realName', u.nickname AS 'nickname', u.email as 'email', u.avatar AS 'avatar', u.super_admin AS 'superAdmin', u.`status` AS 'status', u.gender AS 'gender' FROM sys_user AS u WHERE u.id = #{uId}

SELECT u.id AS id, u.dept_id AS 'deptId', u.tenant_id AS 'tenantId', u.username AS 'username', u.`password` AS 'password', u.real_name AS 'realName', u.nickname AS 'nickname', u.email as 'email', u.avatar AS 'avatar', u.super_admin AS 'superAdmin', u.`status` AS 'status', u.gender AS 'gender' FROM sys_user AS u WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT u.id AS id, u.dept_id AS 'deptId', u.tenant_id AS 'tenantId', u.username AS 'username', u.`password` AS 'password', u.real_name AS 'realName', u.nickname AS 'nickname', u.email as 'email', u.avatar AS 'avatar', u.super_admin AS 'superAdmin', u.`status` AS 'status', u.gender AS 'gender' FROM sys_user AS u WHERE u.email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT r.auth from sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_role_user u ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT auth_code FROM sys_menu WHERE auth_code IS NOT NULL AND auth_code != ''

select t3.auth_code from sys_role_user t1 left join sys_role_menu t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id left join sys_menu t3 on t2.menu_id = t3.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} AND auth_code IS NOT NULL AND auth_code != '' order by t3.sort asc
select t2.dept_id from sys_role_user t1, sys_role_data_scope t2 where t1.user_id = #{value} and t1.role_id = t2.role_id
